title: The Vietnam Adventure
highlights: Travel with a group of like-minded people like you and make lasting memories through shared adventures, new friendships, and unforgettable moments across Vietnam.
Sail along the Mekong Delta and explore floating villages, canals, and local life along the river.
Ride the Ba Na Hills cable car, walk on the iconic Golden Bridge, and spend the day surrounded by mountain views, new friends and fun at Fantasy Park.
Cruise through Halong Bay, enjoying good food, music, and onboard activities as limestone cliffs and emerald waters surround you.
Departure dates (2025-2026): Dec 23, Jan 23, Feb 9, Feb 23 and Mar 15.
overview: Experience the best of Vietnam on this fun and social 7-day group tour designed for adventurous travellers. Start your journey in Ho Chi Minh City, explore the famous Cu Chi Tunnels and the scenic Mekong Delta, and then fly to Da Nang for stunning views from the Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills. Discover the charm of Hoi An’s lantern-lit streets before heading to Hanoi, where you’ll enjoy a peaceful cruise through Halong Bay. With internal flights, guided tours, and comfortable stays included, this trip blends history, nature, culture, and connection, making it the perfect Vietnam adventure to enjoy with like-minded travellers.

know_before_you_go: All visitors are required to carry valid ID proof.
Please be aware that the package does not cover the cost of the visa, which must be obtained separately.
Travel insurance is not included in the package.
Alcoholic drinks are not included in the package.
Rooms will be provided in a double and triple sharing basis. If any person wants a room on a single sharing basis then it can be arranged at an additional cost.
Fixed transfer time slots for Airport Pickup is 8 AM to 11 AM.
Fixed transfer time slots for Airport Drop is 1PM.
All reservations must be made at least 7 days prior to the scheduled date of travel.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City | Meet Your Travel Crew
days.desc: Upon arrival in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam’s buzzing southern capital packed with life, color, and energy, get transferred to your hotel. Check in at the hotel before meeting your travel group. Spend the afternoon chilling by the pool, grabbing coffee at a local spot, or exploring the nearby streets together. In the evening, head out with your new friends for a relaxed dinner or casual drinks as you kick off your Vietnam adventure.

days.title: Visit to Cu Chi Tunnels & Mekong Delta
days.desc: Today, head out with your group to uncover Vietnam’s history and charm. Explore the famous Cu Chi Tunnels and see how locals once lived and fought underground during the war. Later, cruise through the Mekong Delta, passing lush green fields and quiet riverside villages. Enjoy tropical fruits, local snacks, and the calm rhythm of river life before returning to Ho Chi Minh City for the night.

days.title: Flight to Da Nang | Hoi An Evening Tour
days.desc: Fly to Da Nang with your group and check in before setting out together for an evening walking tour of Hoi An. Explore the Japanese Covered Bridge, Sa Huynh Museum, and Phuoc Kien Assembly Hall. Watch local artisans make silk, shop at the lively Central Market, and capture the charm of lantern-lit streets with your travel crew before heading back to the hotel for the night.

days.title: Day Trip to Ba Na Hills | Visit the Golden Bridge
days.desc: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure to Ba Na Hills, one of Central Vietnam’s must-visit spots. Ride the world-famous cable car over misty mountains, walk along the stunning Golden Bridge, and explore the charming French Village. Have fun at Fantasy Park, click some great photos with your new friends, and enjoy your lunch in the cool mountain air before heading back to Da Nang in the evening. Relax and enjoy some bonding time with the group at the hotel.

items.title: Full-Day Ba Na Hills Tour - Full-Day Ba Na Hills Tour with Lunch and Shared Transfer

days.title: Fly to Hanoi | Day At Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, catch your flight to Hanoi, Vietnam’s lively capital filled with culture and charm. After arriving, get transferred to your hotel and check in. You can spend the day exploring with your group. Take a walk through the Old Quarter, taste local dishes like pho and banh mi, and relax by the beautiful Hoan Kiem Lake. In the evening, you can visit a rooftop bar or a cozy café and enjoy the city’s vibrant nightlife before returning back to the hotel.

items.title: Flight - Da Nang International Airport to Noi Bai International Airport

days.title: Halong Bay Full Day Cruise
days.desc: Sail into one of Vietnam’s most famous natural wonders with your group. Cruise through Halong Bay’s emerald waters surrounded by dramatic limestone cliffs. Enjoy a delicious lunch on board, explore hidden caves, and capture amazing group photos on deck. Spend the day chatting, relaxing, and taking in the stunning scenery before heading back to Hanoi. After returning to Hanoi, spend the evening exploring local nightlife at Ta Hien Street or simply relax with your group at the hotel.

days.title: Departure from Hanoi
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and head to the airport for your flight back home. Say goodbye to your travel group and carry with you wonderful memories of new friendships, stunning views, and unforgettable adventures from your week in Vietnam.
